games.title: Sixth Card
games.description: Everyone plays a card at once and they land lowest first. Put the sixth card on a row and you take the whole row, bull heads and all. Fewest bull heads wins.

games.title: Deep Temple
games.description: Push deeper into the temple or run home with your gems. Everyone decides at the same time. A second hazard of the same kind collapses the tunnel on whoever is still inside.

games.title: MAINLINE
games.description: Four dice, seven rounds, one sheet each. Draw every roll into your own grid of road and rail, join the gateways into one network, and leave no loose ends.

games.title: Gem Duel
games.description: A head-to-head race for gems. Draft tokens from the board, buy cards and claim royals. Win with 20 prestige, 10 crowns or 10 points in one colour.

games.title: Coldwake
games.description: You wake from cryosleep on a dying ship, and something else is awake too. Roll three dice a round, explore the dark decks and reach a way off before the clock runs out. A new ship every run.

games.title: Paper Games
games.description: Tectonic, Binairo and Sudoku, made on the spot. Pick a level and a size and a brand-new puzzle is built for you, with exactly one solution and no guessing needed.

games.title: Frame Feud
games.description: A fighting game played in turns. Both fighters pick a move in secret, then every frame plays out at once. Read the frame data, trust the ghost, and land the hit they never saw coming. Play the computer, a friend on one device, or online.
